units.source_text: 這位警察像法官一樣裝模作樣地詢問我，

en.t: This policeman questioned me with the pompous air of a judge,

units.source_text: 他當我是個小孩，擺出一副審訊主任的派頭，在無聊的秋夜，

en.t: treating me like a child and posing as the officer in charge of the interrogation on that tedious autumn night,

units.source_text: 企圖想從我的口中套出猥瑣的桃色新聞。

en.t: trying to coax some vulgar, scandalous gossip out of me.

units.source_text: 我很快覺察到了這一點，盡力地忍住了笑。

en.t: I quickly sensed what he was after and did my best to hold back my laughter.

units.source_text: 對於這種警察的「非正式審訊」，我知道自己就算拒絕回答也無所謂，

en.t: I knew that with this sort of policeman's informal interrogation, it would not matter if I refused to answer,

units.source_text: 但為了給漫長的秋夜增添一點樂趣，

en.t: but to add a little amusement to the long autumn night,

units.source_text: 我始終表現出一臉誠意，就像深信這位警察是真正的審訊主任，

en.t: I kept up an expression of perfect sincerity, as though I firmly believed this policeman was the real chief interrogator,

units.source_text: 刑法的輕重判決全取決於他的一念之間。

en.t: and that the severity of my punishment under the law depended entirely on his whim.

units.source_text: 我回應了一些適當的「陳述」，以滿足他那顆好奇的淫心。

en.t: I gave him a few suitable statements, enough to satisfy his lewd curiosity.
Well, now I more or less understand.
